label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 (common), early in the episode
explanation: Update-gate unit 21 fires almost only at D2 (87% of activation mass) when the agent chose a2 and the common transition took it to S2. It never fires at D1, and never after an a1 choice or on reaching S1 at D2. The other 13% of mass is at GO steps where the agent is about to choose a2, usually after unrewarded trials. These include the very highest activations, in runs of unrewarded a2 choices that hit the rare S1. The unit is strongly tied to time in the episode: it is silent on trials 0-2, peaks on trials 10-19 and has nearly died out after trial 40. It is also more active in episodes that start with S2 good, and when the value output is high. D2 & a2 & S2 alone gets recall 0.94 but precision 0.07. Restricting to ep_trial < 30 raises F1 to 0.40 (mass recall 0.82). Adding start_high == 0 or good != 1 gains at most 4 F1 points, and conditions on the previous reward or transition made it worse, so the simple predicate is recorded. Within these conditions it still fires on only about a quarter of steps, so precision is incomplete. It probably encodes an early-episode a2->S2 trace whose firing depends on episode time and value, which no clean trial-level variable captures. Only observed inputs (this D2 state and action) and episode time are used.
